text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, hurry! The cafeteria is going to 
close!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the Tenno Sho (Spring), Mejiro 
McQueen has been in great shape.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since today's training finished without a 
hitch, I decided to take a break in the 
cafeteria, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Bzzzt... bzzzt...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, a phone call? Who on earth could it 
be—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Wait... My goodness!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...*pant*, *pant*.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...! No, at this rate...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I just couldn't hold on at the Tenno 
Sho...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen carried herself with so much 
dignity right up until the end, yet...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: And yet—I...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey... don't you think you're running a 
bit too much?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah... Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I wondered where she went so early in the 
morning on her day off, and it turns out 
she's been doing independent training this 
whole time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Push yourself too hard and your body will 
break down. Especially with a race coming 
up."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Still, there are still things that I'm 
lacking.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
The Mejiro family expected me to run in 
the Classics, but... things didn't go as 
planned.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen lived up to everyone's 
expectations flawlessly at the Tenno Sho, 
and yet—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I'm weak... I'm nowhere near good enough.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
My strength, my feelings...! There are 
still so many things I'm lacking...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...I know, because I've been watching you 
all this time. But if you want to win, 
pushing yourself too hard is the last 
thing you should do."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, sorry for making you worry. I'll 
go change and take a short break.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Really...!? My performance...!? I thank 
you from the bottom of my heart!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen stands attentively. It 
seems the person on the other end of the 
phone is the Mejiro family's Grandmamma.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
"‘...I have seen your dedication all 
along. This result is the fruit of your 
hard work.’"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
"Take immense pride in the brilliance 
you've seized through your hard work. And 
then—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
"I hope she will show us a new path. —For 
this time-honored Mejiro family."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Me... show the way...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Forging a new path is difficult, and 
it will require a great deal of resolve, 
but—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Family Matriarch
text_block_list.text:
"‘You'll be fine. Just run the way you 
want to.’"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Me, forging a new path for the Mejiro 
family...? And to think that Grandmother 
herself is placing her hopes in me...
choice_data_list: You earned it by doing that much.
You earned it by doing that much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Is that... really true? It still hasn't 
quite sunk in yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Was it just a coincidence?—Right at that 
moment, I saw an Umamusume walking towards 
us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Was that just now... Grandmother? Saying 
that McQueen will lead the way...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: R-Ryan...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: So you were here as well...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Grandmother really has high hopes for 
McQueen after all."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're right. McQueen won the Tenno Sho, 
and she's always so strong...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ever since I was a kid...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Um, but it still doesn't quite feel real 
to me either—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...! You'll be fine, McQueen! I know it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Because I won the Tenno Sho perfectly, 
just as everyone expected me to!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"So, I think you're the right one to take 
the lead too—but still!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I want to become strong too...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I refuse to push everything onto McQueen 
any longer...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: “—Hey, McQueen! One more time...!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Let's face each other once more! Next 
time... at the Takarazuka Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I definitely won't lose next time. I'll 
win, and then—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'll prove to you that I'm strong enough 
so that you don't have to carry everything 
by yourself!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ryan...
choice_data_list:
Being prepared must mean something like 
this.

Being prepared must mean something like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...It appears so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The resolve to carry the Mejiro family 
name on one's shoulders... It seems that 
resolve is being tested right now.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Ryan told me, "I will prove that I am 
strong."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Then I must prove that I am strong enough 
to convince Ryan as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The Takarazuka Kinen is a race you can't 
run in unless you're chosen by the fan 
vote...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I just hope Ryan realizes that being 
chosen in the first place is amazing in 
itself.
